justification: Both surfaces present a bordered inscribed panel with horizontal lines/registers of incised signs, which is the only real correspondence and a fairly generic one. A shows essentially nothing but eroded lines of text with no discernible figures, whereas B shows a specific figural scene in two registers, seated figures facing an offering table with attendants, so the depicted subject matter scarcely overlaps.
